# SumoLab

> SumoLab provides fractional CMO and senior marketing leadership for established businesses generating $5M–$50M in annual revenue. Founded by Jerry Suhrstedt, a marketing operator with 28 years of experience, based in the Phoenix, Arizona metro area and serving clients nationwide.

SumoLab's core services are fractional CMO engagements, fractional marketing director engagements, and AI marketing consulting — senior marketing leadership without the cost of a full-time executive hire.

## Services

- [Fractional CMO](https://sumolab.co/services/fractional-cmo/): Senior marketing strategy and leadership on a part-time engagement for mid-market businesses.
- [Fractional Marketing Director](https://sumolab.co/services/fractional-marketing-director/): Hands-on marketing department leadership — planning, team direction, and execution accountability.
- [AI Marketing Consultant](https://sumolab.co/services/fractional-ai-advisor/): Practical AI adoption for marketing teams — strategy, tooling, and workflow integration.
- [Fractional CMO Near Me](https://sumolab.co/fractional-cmo-near-me/): Local fractional CMO services for Phoenix, Scottsdale, Chandler, Tempe, Mesa, and Gilbert, Arizona.
